Sydney Family Lost in Valley After 100-Meter High Wave

A Sydney family was last known to be in a valley when a wave approximately 100 meters high struck the area. The specific location of the valley has been identified as the family's last known whereabouts. Details regarding the family's fate or the exact location of the event were not provided in the coverage.
